mapper.insert: insert into token_usage (user_id, model, type, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost_cny) values (#{userId}, #{model}, #{type}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{costCny})
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, coalesce(sum(cost_cny), 0) as totalCost, coalesce(sum(case when create_time >= curdate() then total_tokens else 0 end), 0) as todayTokens, coalesce(sum(case when create_time >= curdate() then cost_cny else 0 end), 0) as todayCost, coalesce(sum(case when create_time >= date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-01') then total_tokens else 0 end), 0) as monthTokens, coalesce(sum(case when create_time >= date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-01') then cost_cny else 0 end), 0) as monthCost, coalesce(sum(prompt_tokens), 0) as promptTokens, coalesce(sum(completion_tokens), 0) as completionTokens from token_usage where user_id = #{userId} and type = 'chat'

select coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, coalesce(sum(cost_cny), 0) as totalCost, coalesce(sum(case when create_time >= curdate() then total_tokens else 0 end), 0) as todayTokens, coalesce(sum(case when create_time >= date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-01') then total_tokens else 0 end), 0) as monthTokens from token_usage where type = 'embedding'

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as tokens, coalesce(sum(cost_cny), 0) as cost from token_usage where create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) and (user_id = #{userId} or type = 'embedding') group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by day
